title: The Insane Battle To Sabotage a New Apartment Building Explains San Francisco's Housing Crisis
summary: ReasonTV tells the story of Bob Tillman, who spent nearly five years and $1.4 million trying to convert his San Francisco laundromat into apartments. It walks through the permitting, appeals and neighborhood opposition he faced.
why: It is HN's go-to concrete example of how local regulation and NIMBYism block new housing in San Francisco and California.

quote.text: Here is a terrific video that everyone should watch that shows how insanely difficult it is to make affordable housing.
